edges.reason: constructor stores the card repository address into freeDnaCardRepository.
constructor stores the CryptoServal address into cryptoServal.
constructor sets startTimestamp.
constructor sets endTimestamp.
constructor sets periodDuration.
constructor sets cardsByPeriod.
constructor parameter is cast and assigned to cryptoServal.
constructor parameter is cast and assigned to freeDnaCardRepository.
constructor parameter flows into startTimestamp.
constructor parameter flows into endTimestamp.
constructor parameter flows into periodDuration.
constructor parameter flows into cardsByPeriod.
withdraw reads msg.sender as beneficiary and storage key.
msg.sender indexes addressHasWithdraw into senderHasWithdraw.
withdraw reads now for the time window checks.
block.timestamp drives the withdrawal window validation, a timestamp dependency.
startTimestamp is compared against now in the time window check.
endTimestamp is compared against now in the time window check.
withdraw requires the timestamp dependent window before proceeding.
getCurrentPeriodKey result is stored in currentPeriodKey.
withdraw calls getCurrentPeriodKey to derive currentPeriodKey.
withdraw performs an external call to the card repository.
msg.sender is forwarded as the recipient of the external airdrop call.
getRandomAnimalId result is passed as the animalId argument of the external call.
state increment periodDonationCount happens after the external call, enabling reentrant withdrawals.
senderHasWithdraw is only marked true after the external call returns.
unsafe increment writes back to periodDonationCount.
periodDonationCount value is read and modified by the increment.
senderHasWithdraw write updates addressHasWithdraw.
addressHasWithdraw entry is read into the local senderHasWithdraw.
withdraw executes the unchecked counter increment.
hasAvailableCard uses msg.sender to query the withdrawal flag.
hasAvailableCard reads now through getCurrentPeriodKey.
block.timestamp is converted into a period key.
hasAvailableCard computes the current period key.
periodDonationCount is compared against cardsByPeriod in the availability check.
cardsByPeriod bounds the availability check.
getAvailableCardCount reads cardsByPeriod.
getAvailableCardCount reads periodDonationCount.
getAvailableCardCount reads now via getCurrentPeriodKey.
getAvailableCardCount performs an unchecked subtraction.
cardsByPeriod is the minuend of the raw subtraction.
periodDonationCount is the subtrahend, allowing underflow.
subtraction result is returned by getAvailableCardCount.
getNextPeriodTimestamp reads now via getCurrentPeriodKey.
getNextPeriodTimestamp calls getCurrentPeriodKey.
current period key incremented into nextPeriodKey.
nextPeriodKey is returned by getNextPeriodTimestamp.
getNextPeriodTimestamp reads periodDuration for the multiplication.
periodDuration multiplies the next period key.
getRandomNumber consumes the max parameter.
getRandomNumber uses now as entropy source.
getRandomNumber evaluates now modulo max.
block.timestamp feeds the modulo randomness computation.
max parameter bounds the modulo computation.
modulo result is returned by getRandomNumber.
getAnimalCount queries the cryptoServal state reference.
getRandomAnimalId calls getRandomNumber.
getRandomAnimalId bounds randomness with getAnimalCount.
getPeriodKey divides the atTime parameter.
getPeriodKey reads periodDuration as divisor.
periodDuration participates in the period key division.
getCurrentPeriodKey uses now as input timestamp.
getCurrentPeriodKey delegates to getPeriodKey.
